name: weird level
author: arbieyt
description: When You Enter The Yellow Gravity Portal At 44% Make 2 Very Fast Clicks And Click The Pink Orb Late To Skip The Blue Gravity Portal, Go Between The Two Trunks And Click The Black Orb Very Early, If Done Right You Will Be Over The Main Path In Reverse Gravity, Maintain A Position Near The Ceiling For The Rest Of The Level To Not Die To The Invisible Sawblades.
